How confidence is setIt follows the kind of evidence, not judgement.
  • The customer's own statement (high confidence at most): The organisation says so itself: its press release, website, annual report or a named executive on the record.
  • Regulatory or securities filing (high confidence at most): A filing by the customer or the vendor names the relationship.
  • Independent press (high confidence at most): Editorially independent reporting describes the deployment.
  • Joint announcement (medium confidence at most): A press release issued with the vendor, usually with a quote from the customer.
  • Vendor case study (medium confidence at most): The vendor's published customer story naming the organisation.
  • Vendor mention only (low confidence at most): A logo, a customer list or a passing mention by the vendor, with nothing from the customer.
  • An organisation that also holds a stake in the vendor is labelled “Investor and customer” and is never rated above medium.
  • A partnership is listed as a partner, not a customer.

Timeline

  1. 2026-11-19 · acquisition Elastic
    Elastic signs agreement to acquire agent observability firm HoneyHive

    Elastic said in a blog post dated 19 November 2026, and in its second-quarter fiscal 2027 results released the same day, that it has entered into an agreement to acquire HoneyHive, an AI agent observability and evaluation company. Elastic plans to bring HoneyHive's tracing and evaluation features into Elastic Observability. The deal had not closed at the time of the announcement and no terms were disclosed. Elastic (vendor, retrieved 2026-11-22, opens in new tab)Elastic (vendor, retrieved 2026-11-20, opens in new tab)

  2. 2026-11-18 · launch Elastic
    Elastic makes Jina embeddings v5 text and omni models available in Microsoft Foundry

    Elastic announced in a press release dated 18 November 2026 that its Jina embeddings v5 text and omni models are in the Microsoft Foundry model catalog, where customers can deploy them as dedicated endpoints in their own Azure environments. The release says the omni models cover image, audio and video in one vector space. Elastic (vendor, retrieved 2026-11-22, opens in new tab)

  3. 2026-10-08 · launch Elastic
    Elastic announces AlertZero AI agents for Elastic Security in technical preview

    Elastic announced AlertZero, a layer of specialised AI agents in Elastic Security organised into triage, hunt, detection and forensics 'Watches', with analysts setting how much each may do without approval. It is a technical preview for Elastic Cloud, self-managed and air-gapped deployments and works with a model of the customer's choice. No pricing was given. Elastic (vendor, retrieved 2026-11-20, opens in new tab)

  4. 2026-06-23 · layoff Elastic
    Elastic commits to plan reducing its workforce by about 7%

    Disclosed by Elastic in a Form 8-K filed on 2026-06-24: on 2026-06-23 the company committed to a plan to reduce its workforce by approximately 7%, with non-recurring cash charges of about US$22 million to US$25 million, mostly severance, and reductions substantially complete by the end of the third quarter of fiscal 2027. The company said it would keep hiring in priority areas and expected total headcount to grow over the fiscal year. The chief executive's message to staff, published the same day, cited AI and automation changing how work is done. U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (primary filing, retrieved 2026-11-20, opens in new tab)Elastic (vendor, retrieved 2026-11-20, opens in new tab)

  5. 2026-06-18 · leadership change Elastic
    Elastic chief product officer Ken Exner resigns; engineering leaders report to the CEO

    Elastic's Form 8-K filed on 2026-06-24 reported that chief product officer Ken Exner gave notice on 2026-06-18, with a last day of 2026-07-17, to pursue another opportunity and not because of any disagreement. Senior engineering leaders, including the head of the Observability and Security group, now report directly to the chief executive. No successor was named. U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (primary filing, retrieved 2026-11-20, opens in new tab)

  6. 2026-03-02 · outage Elastic
    Elastic Cloud's AWS Bahrain region becomes unavailable; still unresolved in November 2026

    Disclosed by Elastic on its status page: a connectivity disruption in the AWS Bahrain (me-south-1) region was first posted on 2026-03-02, citing localised power issues. An update on 2026-09-21 stated that the region had been removed from selection for new deployments, that existing deployments there were inaccessible because of an AWS infrastructure disruption with no recovery timeline, and that customers should assume the region is unavailable for the foreseeable future. The incident was still open on 2026-11-20. Other regions were shown as operational. Elastic (vendor, retrieved 2026-11-20, opens in new tab)

  7. 2025-10-09 · acquisition Elastic
    Elastic completes acquisition of embedding-model developer Jina AI

    Elastic announced on 2025-10-09 that it had completed the acquisition of Jina AI, a developer of open-source multilingual and multimodal embedding models, rerankers and small language models. Elastic said the models would be offered through the Elastic Inference Service on Elastic Cloud alongside its vector database and would continue to be published openly. The release did not disclose the price. Elastic (vendor, retrieved 2026-11-21, opens in new tab)

  8. 2025-02-11 · litigation Elastic
    Securities suit filed against Elastic N.V. in the Eastern District of New York

    According to the CourtListener federal docket index, searched on 2026-11-20, Lucid Alternative Fund, LP v. Elastic N.V. (1:25-cv-00785) was filed in the Eastern District of New York on 11 February 2025 under the Securities Exchange Act, and no termination date is shown. The claims were not retrieved. In its fiscal 2026 annual report Elastic states that it is not party to any legal proceeding that would have a material adverse effect on it.
